children: The KAITO supply unlock is scheduled for July 2027. It covers up to 17.6 million tokens, or 7.29% of circulating supply, across allocations for the community, ecosystem, foundation, investors, liquidity and team.
The unlock lets recipients sell tokens they could not previously sell. If recipients put some of those tokens on the market, the additional supply can put downward pressure on the token's price.

title: KAITO: Up to 17.6 million tokens unlock - Jul 2027
